test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

One who offers one’s services without being forced
solution: The correct answer is **option 3, Volunteer.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • A **volunteer **is **someone who offers their services without being forced or paid. ** **​​**स्‍वयंसेवक (बिना किसी शुल्क अथवा दबाव के कुछ करने को तैयार) • For example, a person who volunteers at a soup kitchen or a hospital is offering their time and skills without expecting anything in return. • Overall, the best word to substitute for** "One who offers one's services without being forced"** is **Volunteer**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Option 1, Skeptic,** refers to someone who doubts or questions something. **किस बात की सच्‍चाई, औचित्‍य आदि में संशय करने वाला; संशयवादी, संशयात्‍मा** • For example, a skeptic might question the validity of a scientific study. • **Option 2, Altruist**, refers to someone who is selfless and puts the needs of others before their own. **एक निःस्वार्थ व्यक्ति जिसके कार्यों में दूसरों के कल्याण की चिंता झलकती है।** • For example, a person who donates a large sum of money to a charity is acting altruistically. • **Option 4, **Scholar, refers to someone who is knowledgeable in a particular field of study. **विद्वान, पंडित (विषय-विशेष का)** • For example, a scholar of literature might be an expert in Shakespearean plays. 4a:T5ab, Here the correct answer is **To stop paying attention for a moment.**
